title: Why Sanitary Tees Fail on Horizontal Drain Lines
description: Installing a standard sanitary tee in a horizontal-to-horizontal drainage direction is a common installation mistake that leads to frequent clogs. Sanitary tees feature a short radius turn designed specifically for transitioning from horizontal branch lines into vertical waste stacks. When installed horizontally, waste flow loses momentum, causing solids to drop out of fluid suspension and accumulate in the branch. Plumbing codes require long-sweep fittings, such as a combination wye and eighth bend, for horizontal branch connections to direct waste fluid smoothly downstream. Always verify local code requirements for approved fitting sweep radii.
